launch_abi.branch_records_status: One counter per primal guarded arithmetic call site, plus inactive topology entries. Captured fast configuration compiles out helper fallbacks. The strict sibling-state experiment covers both sides and a crossing at the inverse-area multiplication and sum addition; the first multiplication fallback is excluded for finite f32 PV on that captured mesh.
launch_abi.failure_slot_status: One atomic int32 flag per listed source ID. Captured baseline, vertex primal, inverse-area primal, vertex tangent and cell-output cotangent injection cases pass on both own captures. Other source predicates have not all been individually injected.

seed_lifetime_contract: Snapshot each incoming output seed before the reverse launch. The outgoing pre-state cotangent is a separate accumulator; the inout seed is consumed only at forward-overwritten elements. Do not add an untouched seed twice when materializing the pre-state cotangent.
